This file contains the Provisioning module definitions which are common across the client and server.

detaileddescription.para: The Provisioning module implements the ASU Provisioning Interface (SAS section 12.16). It supports programming the USER eFUSE keys. USER_EFUSE_KEY_0 is programmed in black form only. USER_EFUSE_KEY_1 accepts both black (PUF KEK encrypted) and red (unencrypted) via KeyForm. Red USER key 1 can be used by both PLM and ASU. Black USER key 0 and black USER key 1 are subsystem-exclusive; choose black provisioning with the intended end use case in mind.
